Name: Marlon from the School of the Wolf
Author: neosinf
Description:
=================================================
Stardew Druid: Marlon from the School of the Wolf
=================================================

Did Marlon ever tell you that he survived the Trial of the Grasses?

This mod doesn't do anything on it's own. Instead it tells Stardew Druid, the main mod, to switch aesthetic for Marlon when he appears in Stardew Druid content. 

[color=#f6b26b]NOTE: Because the assets for this mod are packaged in Stardew Druid, this extension does not need to be downloaded and installed to be enabled for players who have 'gothic versions' set to true in their Stardew Druid configuration file.[/color]

Marlon's appearance in events, cutscenes and at the adventurer's guild, whether changed by other mods or not, remains unaffected.

This mod can be enabled and disabled without affecting save files or progression in Stardew Druid.

------------------------------------
How do I recruit Marlon?
------------------------------------

If you're familiar with Stardew Druid, and you've unlocked the Gift of the Heiress in your playthrough, then you'll know what to do, just cast Rite of Mists: Smite on Marlon when you see him onscreen.

Once you see the 'Marlon has been added to the ledger of recruits' notice, go to the Stardew Druid journal, press the lightning sword icon to open the ledger menu, click on Marlon's entry, then click the check box to summon him.

If you are not interested in a Druid playthrough, you can use the set progress feature in the Stardew Druid configuration to skip right to the Gift of the Heiress unlock, which is progress 30.

Alternatively, the recruit system is immediately available for Magic only mode users of Stardew Druid (either by setting in config or by using the Magic By Neosinf mod).
